title: A Postcard for the Summer
author: Kestrel Reyes
blurb: Noor Hartwell, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
